messages:
lina_support: FYI customer (acme/raj) is seeing tool/function-calling break after last rollout (r-2026-03-14). They say previously the model would call our actions with arguments, now it's either returning plain text or calling the wrong tool. repro attached.

raj_acme (pasted to us):
```
POST /v1/chat/completions
{ "model": "redwood-chat-v2", "messages": [{"role":"user","content":"Please fetch invoice 12345 and return the total as JSON"}], "functions": [{"name":"get_invoice","parameters":{"type":"object","properties":{"id":{"type":"string"}}}}], "function_call": "auto" }
```
Response (they got):
```
{ "id":"resp_abc123", "object":"chat.completion","choices":[{"message":{"role":"assistant","content":"Invoice 12345 total is $X,XXX.XX"}}]}
```
No function_call object. Previously they'd get a choice.message.function_call name + arguments.

lina_support: They attached request_id: req-20260314-55cb and a few other examples where the model calls the wrong tool (e.g., calls `get_customer` instead of `get_invoice`) or returns text. Their usage started failing right after our v2 rollout (we rolled at ~r-2026-03-14T03:10Z).

jordan_oncall: @lina_support thanks — can you share the raw request/response headers + model_version returned from response metadata? need request ids to trace in infra logs.

lina_support: Pasted two full redwood logs from the customer (sanitized):
```
--REQUEST--
X-Request-Id: req-20260314-55cb
Model: redwood-chat-v2
Payload: (same as above)
--RESPONSE--
200 OK
Content-Type: application/json
X-Model-Version: redwood-chat-v2-alpha:20260314
Body: {"id":"resp_abc123","choices":[{"message":{"role":"assistant","content":"Invoice 12345 total is $1,234.56"}}]}
```

mike_ml: Hmm, model_version shows `-alpha:20260314`. We did push a new routing variant for v2 on that date that switches to the new tool-hint decoder. Suspect mismatch between tool spec ingestion and the new decoder. Could be that the function_call token biasing isn't being applied for some routes.

sara_eng: Oncall, could you check the serving logs for req-20260314-55cb? I want to see the model internal trace (tool suggestion score) and whether the function_call field was dropped by the response formatter.

jordan_oncall: I'm tailing logs now. infra-bot shows the request hit cluster cluster-infer-07 in us-west-2 and was routed to runtime-shard-23. Pulling model trace...

deploy-bot: Deploy r-2026-03-14 completed: route=stable -> variant alpha (traffic 100%). Canary finished at 03:12Z with no errors flagged by deploy health check.

jordan_oncall: Found the internal trace: model produced a function_call token sequence but the response postprocessor discarded it because the function name didn't match any loaded function in that shard. Looks like the function registry on shard-23 is stale (missing get_invoice entry), so it's converting to assistant text.

lina_support: So the model asked for the function but we didn't have it registered -> returns text. Customer sees wrong behavior. Can we confirm other shards have it, or if the registry sync failed during rollout?

mike_ml: That fits. The new routing changed which shard serves some traffic; rollout may have exposed a race in function manifest propagation. Short-term fix: pin customer to previous variant (stable-old) or route them to a shard with correct registry. Long-term: add stronger manifest handshake in runtime start and hard fail on mismatch.

sara_eng: I'll open a hotfix PR to add an explicit function-manifest checksum verification at runtime startup + a fast reconciliation job. Also adding an alert when a model emits function_call but no registry match.

tom_pm: We need to communicate to the customer. @lina_support propose we 1) acknowledge, 2) offer immediate mitigation (pin to old variant or route to other region), 3) ETA for hotfix. Any objections?

lina_support: Agreed. I'll offer routing pin and ask if they can tolerate small latency change. Also asked for any additional repros and the exact times. I told them we're escalating to eng and will follow up within 2 hours. :+1:

jordan_oncall: For now I'm manually rerouting req-20260314-55cb to shard-05 (has correct registry) — infra-bot confirmed. Waiting for customer to retry.

infra-bot: Reroute applied: req-20260314-55cb now served by runtime-shard-05.

lina_support: Customer retried and confirmed function_call returned correctly now. They're still worried about other calls. I noted we'll push rollout fix and add a regression test.

mike_ml: Action items: (1) sara to PR runtime manifest check; (2) infra to add a pre-rollout registry sync verification; (3) qa to add a smoke test that emits function_call for each function in manifest; (4) product to update rollout checklist. I'll own the regression alert and add it to Redwood Optimize alerts.

sara_eng: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/runtime/pulls/789 — adding checksum + immediate reconcile. Deploy leaning to hotfix tomorrow morning if no blocker.

tom_pm: I'll draft customer update and coordinate with support for postmortem. Keep me posted.

lina_support: Closing loop: customer thanked us and will wait for timeline. I'll mark this escalated and file a postmortem after hotfix. :white_check_mark:
